description: This header defines template classes and functions for custom formatting of objects, including support for optional values, prefix formatting, and deferred formatting via functors. It is part of a support library for formatting within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: custom_formattable
classes.description: A template class that holds a formatting functor for deferred formatting.

classes.name: value_or_else
classes.description: A template struct that holds an optional value, a unit string, and an else string for conditional formatting.

classes.name: optional_prefix_formatter
classes.description: A template struct that formats an optional value with a prefix if the value is set.

methods.name: make_formattable
methods.description: Creates a custom_formattable object with a user-provided formatting functor.

methods.name: format_value_or
methods.description: Creates a value_or_else object that formats an optional value or a fallback string.

methods.name: format_unit_or
methods.description: Creates a value_or_else object that formats an optional value with a unit string or a fallback string.

methods.name: add_prefix_if_set
methods.description: Creates an optional_prefix_formatter that prefixes an optional value if it is set.
